subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and port https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Channels page resolver fix, or ask for a fresh current-main PR?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible, but an open linked PR already owns the implementation path and is stale against current UI file locations, so a human should choose adoption versus replacement before automation starts duplicate work.

options.title: Adopt and port the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused resolver/test approach, update it for the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` structure, and refresh proof before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh current-main PR
options.body: Leave the stale fork PR aside and ask for a new narrow Control UI resolver PR with current paths and real behavior or test evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt and port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused resolver/test approach, update it for the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` structure, and refresh proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata/catalog boundary and whether the existing fork patch should be adopted or replaced.
